# RWA1.net Accelerator

Seattle USA Mobile Home Tokenization Project - 太空舱移动式住宅 RWA Tokenization.

RWA1.net tokenizes a 5-acre land development in Puyallup, Washington State USA
(20,000 sqm, near WSU Puyallup campus and Pierce College, 30 min from SEA airport).
Mixed-use redevelopment: outlets, capsule hotel, prefabricated mobile housing units,
serviced apartments, commercial offices. Financing via compliant STO (ERC-3643,
Reg D / Reg S, SEC S-1 planned), with EB-5 investment immigration integration.

- Tokenization partner: Com2000.org AI+Web3 Accelerator (SEC S-1: CIK 1886086)
- Token model: STO-Seattle-RE, ERC-3643, USDC distributions via smart contracts
- SpacePod proposal: PRO-RWA-001, Wyoming USA, SpacePod Property Token (SPT), ERC-1404
- Contact: IR@Com2000.com, PR@Com2000.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/rwa1/
- Canonical site: https://rwa1.net/
